summary: Found undeclared dependency on jsonwebtoken, unvalidated secret configuration, and an ephemeral runtime state file added to git.

findings.title: Undeclared dependency 'jsonwebtoken'
findings.body: src/token.js requires 'jsonwebtoken', but it is missing from dependencies in package.json, which will cause a MODULE_NOT_FOUND error in production.

findings.title: Unvalidated JWT_SECRET environment variable
findings.body: jwt.sign is called with process.env.JWT_SECRET without checking if it is defined; an unset secret causes jwt.sign to throw a runtime error.
findings.recommendation: Validate that process.env.JWT_SECRET is present before signing or provide an explicit configuration check.

findings.title: Stray runtime state file tracked in git
findings.body: .omc/state/job.json contains ephemeral process metadata and should not be committed to the repository.
findings.recommendation: Remove .omc/state/job.json from git and add .omc/ to .gitignore.
